hero.name: Saipranith Swargam
hero.description: I'm a backend engineer (~2 years incl. internship) who owns services end to end, from design to production metrics and alerts. I work in Python and Go on Kafka, Elasticsearch, PostgreSQL and Kubernetes, and I like measurable wins: an API made 11x faster, Kafka traffic cut 6x, and a 155k-record data load with zero failed batches.

cards.title: Backend & Data Systems
cards.description: Microservices, data pipelines and APIs in Python (Django) and Go, built on Kafka, NATS, Elasticsearch, PostgreSQL, ClickHouse and Redis. I profile first, then fix: query rewrites, aggregation redesigns, batching and async processing.

cards.title: Reliability & Observability
cards.description: Services instrumented with OpenTelemetry and Prometheus, health probes and alert rules across production clusters, shipped on Kubernetes with Helm and Argo CD. Plus side projects in stream processing and AI tooling.
